structure_rebuild_system_v2.disposition_reason: These ten sites are reviewed clean masters carrying a hand-authored narrative revision layer. Section 6's regenerate-from-primitives instruction targets the wasteland family masters, which have no such layer; regenerating these would discard the revision work to fix defects that measured small and localised. Repaired with scripts/old_world_v2_compliance.py instead. Zero authored blocks were removed wave-wide; 20 glass blocks were converted to door frames to open sealed chambers.
structure_rebuild_system_v2.baseline_note: Taken from a standalone scan of the pre-retrofit .nbt corpus. OWS-004 and OWS-009 were reported as 41 findings each by the linter's per-structure report cap; the totals recorded here are the true counts the cap's summary line named.
structure_rebuild_system_v2.human_gate_still_required: Passing checks 1-3 is not production approval. Section 6 point 4 still requires a QA-world walkthrough and a pass row in structure_library/review/*.csv with reviewer and timestamp.

verified_intentional.OWS-015: The flagged void is the water tower's own tank vessel. A sealed tank is what a water tower is; the lint names this case explicitly and asks for verification, not a door. Verified and left alone. The finding is deliberately still reported rather than suppressed, so the next reader re-checks it instead of inheriting a silent exemption.
